metadata.description: One-time password input with multiple character fields for 2FA and verification codes

componentSpecific.name: value
componentSpecific.helpText: Current OTP value as string or number

componentSpecific.name: length
componentSpecific.helpText: Determines how many character fields to display (default: 4)

componentSpecific.name: mask
componentSpecific.description: Whether to mask the input characters
componentSpecific.helpText: When true, displays dots instead of actual characters

componentSpecific.name: integerOnly
componentSpecific.description: Whether to accept only numeric input

styling.name: className
styling.description: Additional CSS classes for custom styling
styling.helpText: Supports PrimeFlex utility classes and custom CSS

simplified.name: onValueChange
simplified.description: Simplified callback with just the value

validation.name: onComplete
validation.description: Callback when all fields are filled

internal: handleChange(e): Processes onChange event and calls onValueChange if provided
handleComplete(value): Calls onComplete when all fields are filled
patterns: For Redux: Use onValueChange to dispatch actions directly with the value
For validation: Use onValidate to check OTP format and onComplete for submission

childComponentInfo.childrenDescription: This component does not accept children

usageExamples.withEvents: <InputOtpWrapper value={otp} onChange={(e) => setOtp(e.value)} onComplete={(value) => verifyOtp(value)} length={6} />
usageExamples.withValidation: <InputOtpWrapper value={otp} onChange={(e) => setOtp(e.value)} onValidate={(value) => value.length === 6} onComplete={(value) => submitOtp(value)} length={6} />
